claims.name: SystemServicesController
responsibilities: facade exposing system operations to the GUI boundary

claims.name: ReportService
responsibilities: retrieves submitted, received and detailed reports as maps

claims.name: PersistenceService
responsibilities: generic JPA save, update and find operations

claims.label: registerUser(registrationData): boolean; returns false on null data, rethrows IllegalArgumentException
createReport(userId, reportData): boolean; false on null args or RuntimeException
findById(User.class, userId) then save(report); returns null if user is not a Citizen or data is invalid
claims.condition: user is a Citizen and required fields are non-blank

claims.label: retrieveReportsSubmitted(userId): List<Map<String,Object>>; findByFields on citizenReporting.userId; null if userId null
retrieveDetailsReport(userId, reportId): Map; findById(Report) and findByFields(Notification) on report.reportId
claims.condition: userId and reportId not null and report exists

claims.name: PersistenceService.save
responsibilities: save(T): persists entity in a transaction, rolls back on RuntimeException and rethrows
throws IllegalArgumentException if object is null

claims.name: PersistenceService.update
responsibilities: update(T): merges entity in a transaction, rolls back on failure
throws IllegalArgumentException if object is null

claims.name: PersistenceService.findByAttribute
responsibilities: findByAttribute(Class<T>, String, Object): List<T> equality query on one attribute
throws IllegalArgumentException for null class or empty attribute

claims.name: PersistenceService.findByFields
responsibilities: findByFields(Class<T>, Map<String,Object>): List<T> AND-combined equality query
throws IllegalArgumentException for null class or empty field name

claims.name: PersistenceService.findById
responsibilities: findById(Class<T>, Long): T, returns null if class or id is null

claims.name: reports_db
responsibilities: MySQL database accessed through JPA EntityManager
